caption:
💩😖 Is your child constipated? Here's what really helps.

🔎 Signs: fewer than 3 poos a week · hard, large or pellet-like poo · pain or straining · holding back, crossing legs · tummy pain, eating less

💚 What helps:
1️⃣ Water & fluids through the day
2️⃣ Fibre: fruits, vegetables, dal, whole grains
3️⃣ Toilet time after meals, 5–10 minutes
4️⃣ Active play every day

💊 Doctor gave a laxative? Continue it for weeks. Stopping too early = it comes back.

❌ Please don't:
• Give lots of cow's milk
• Scold or punish
• Use enemas or home remedies on your own
• Stop the medicine suddenly

🩺 See a doctor soon if:
• Constipation since birth or the first weeks
• Baby took over 48 h to pass the first poo
• Swollen tummy with vomiting
• Blood in the poo
• Weak legs or a problem in the lower back
• Weight loss or poor growth
